purpose: Teach: ふざけ/こだわら/街角/傾ける/間に合っ/ちらっと/町中/見回し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、休み時間、皆でふざけて笑った。
lines.en: Yesterday during breaks, all of us were just messing around and laughing.
lines.style: Bright, fast-paced opening. Light energy on the memory. Slight lift at the end—like she's enjoying telling it. Genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。細かい点に、こだわらない方が、楽だよ。
lines.en: Yeah. It's easier when you don't get hung up on the small stuff.
lines.style: Slow, measured. Slight pause before the observation—like he's actually thinking it through rather than just agreeing. Calm, almost gentle underneath the casualness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の街角、新しいカフェ、できた。
lines.en: There's a new café that opened by the station.
lines.style: Quick, animated delivery. Energy lifts on 'new'—like she's excited about sharing this. Forward-leaning, conversational tempo.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 頭、横に傾けるくせ、つい出る。
lines.en: I've got this habit of tilting my head sideways. It just comes out.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware tone. Slight smile-smirk underneath. A touch of self-consciousness—like he's caught himself doing something he can't help. Modest pace, casual admission.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日、ぎりぎり間に合った、電車。
lines.en: I barely made the train this morning.
lines.style: Quieter, a bit breathless—like the close call is still with her. Matter-of-fact but with an undercurrent of relief. No drama, just stating the fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 隣の教室、ちらっと覗いたら、騒がしかった。
lines.en: I peeked into the next classroom and it was pretty loud in there.
lines.style: Observant, slightly detached. Measured pace. A hint of curiosity—like he noticed something worth noting. Quiet reflection, not commentary.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 町中、お祭りの準備、賑やか。
lines.en: The whole town is buzzing with festival preparations.
lines.style: Enthusiastic, bright. Pace picks up. Genuinely pleased by the liveliness around her. Open-ended, inviting—like she's painting the scene for him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 迷子の犬を見回しながら、探した。
lines.en: I was walking around looking for a lost dog.
lines.style: Warm, present-tense sincerity. Gentle pace—grounded in the moment of the search. A touch of quiet care underneath. Almost tender about it.
